subject: Architecture deep-dive: Hosted API integration (SDKs, streaming, tool calling) — scheduling
messages:
From: Jordan Matthews <jordan.m@finbot.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha@finbot.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00Z
Subject: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs/streaming/tool calling)

Hi Rachel,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at FinBot liked the latency numbers. We'd like to do a deeper architecture session focused on how Redwood's Hosted API will integrate with our event-driven pipeline. Key things we'd like to cover:

- SDK usage patterns and auth flows (service account vs user tokens)
- Streaming (partial responses, reconnect handling, long-polling)
- Tool/function calling and best practices for structured outputs
- KV cache/prefix caching expectations and how it affects throughput
- Rollout strategy for model variants and fallbacks

We're thinking a 60–75 minute session. Proposed windows next week (all times UTC):
- Tue 2027-04-20 15:00–16:15
- Wed 2027-04-21 10:00–11:15
- Thu 2027-04-22 16:00–17:15

Can you confirm an owner's availability and whether you can share a short pre-read/runbook before the call? We'll invite our engineering leads (Aisha + one backend eng).

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Matthews
Head of Platform
FinBot AI

-----
Attachment: (none)
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Matthews <jordan.m@finbot.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T17:01:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs/streaming/tool calling)

Jordan — thanks for the clear ask. Happy to run this with our solutions team. I can own the session and will bring Marissa (solutions/SDKs & streaming) and Priyom (integration/runbooks).

Of your proposed windows we have the Thu 2027-04-22 16:00 UTC slot open; I can also do Wed 10:00 UTC if that works better. If you confirm Thu 16:00 we'll block 75 minutes to make sure we have time for a short architecture whiteboard and Q&A.

I've attached a short agenda and our integration runbook draft (stubs below). If you can drop sample request patterns or a short Postman/cURL sample (or tell us your primary SDK language), Marissa will tailor the SDK quickstart.

Agenda (attached: arch_deepdive_agenda.pdf):
1) Introductions & goals (5m)
2) Integration architecture walkthrough (25m)
3) Live demo: SDK + streaming + function calls (20m)
4) Runbook & rollout discussion (15m)
5) Next steps & action items (10m)

Runbook (attached: hosted_integration_runbook.md) — includes auth flows, SLOs, and recommended batching/cache settings.

Do you prefer Zoom or Teams? We usually send a calendar invite with a Zoom link; I'll include a shared Drive folder with pre-reads once time is confirmed.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: arch_deepdive_agenda.pdf (application/pdf), hosted_integration_runbook.md (text/markdown)

Date: 2027-04-19T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: Hosted API architecture deep-dive (SDKs/streaming/tool calling)

Looping in quick: I can take the SDK + streaming portions and will prepare a short demo that shows:

- Node + Python SDK auth & retry pattern
- streaming partial responses and reconnect handling
- example function/tool call with structured JSON output (and a short fallback flow)

Jordan — if you can say whether you're using websockets or long-poll for your ingest path that helps; I'll prepare both snippets. I'm attaching a small zip with sample snippets and a lightweight checklist we use during customer sessions.

Attachments: sdk_streaming_sample.zip (application/zip)

—Marissa
